chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him (peace be upon him) about a man who divorced his wife with one divorce, then left her until her waiting period ended. Then another man married her. Then that man died or divorced her, so the first husband remarried her. He (peace be upon him) said: 'She is with him upon two remaining divorces.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a man remarrying his ex-wife after she has been married to another man following a single divorce?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the status of a woman in a 'Tanzil al-Khula' (or minor) scenario where the first husband divorces her once, she marries another, and that second husband either dies or divorces her without a full consummation or significant separation. Imam al-Sadiq (AS) rules that she returns to the first husband with two divorces remaining, distinguishing this from the major 'Talaq al-Kubra' where three divorces are required for full re-marriage. This ruling highlights the Shia jurisprudential nuance that a single divorce followed by a subsequent marriage and dissolution counts as only one divorce against the first husband, preserving the possibility of two more divorces before the final irrevocable separation.
